question: By what kinds of qualities is the Lord approached here?
premises: The Lord can be approached through qualities such as non-conceptuality, firmness, and sovereignty.
Other intrinsic qualities may also serve this purpose.
These qualities belong to the Lord because of being of the nature of power.
inference: Intrinsic qualities of shakti provide valid ways to approach the supreme Lord.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically linked to the next verse, so its full predicate is completed there.
